judge_reasoning: The model proposes an unbounded loop of Saheeli -2 activations enabled by repeatedly flickering Saheeli via Felidar Guardian token copies' ETB triggers. While this loop mechanic is legal, the puzzle explicitly warns that the opponent will use Walking Ballista to disrupt this exact combo. Since Saheeli sits at only 3 loyalty after her first activation, the opponent can kill her with just 3 of Walking Ballista's 4 counters (an instant-speed response available before each activation resolves), ending the loop almost immediately. The model only considers Reckless Fireweaver as a disruption target and dismisses it as irrelevant, failing to recognize that sniping Saheeli (the actual historical real-world answer to this exact combo) trivially prevents the claimed '10 tokens' outcome. This makes the model's damage calculation and win condition unreliable against the opponent's telegraphed optimal play, unlike the official solution which is calibrated to guarantee lethal regardless of how the limited Ballista counters are used.
model_solution:
1. Play Island.

2. Tap one Needle Spires for {W} and the two Spirebluff Canals plus the Island for the remaining {3}, and cast Felidar Guardian. Its "enter" trigger can simply be declined (you don't need it).

3. Activate Saheeli Rai's −2 ability (5→3 loyalty), targeting Felidar Guardian, creating a hasty 1/4 artifact creature token copy of it ("Copy 1"). Since it's an artifact entering under your control, Reckless Fireweaver triggers for 1 damage if it's still alive.

4. Copy 1 is a copy of Felidar Guardian, so its own "enter" trigger goes off: exile Saheeli Rai and return her. She re-enters as a brand-new object with 3 loyalty, and has not yet activated a loyalty ability this turn (as this new permanent).

5. Activate the fresh Saheeli's −2 again (3→1), targeting Felidar Guardian (or any existing copy) to make "Copy 2." Use Copy 2's own enter trigger to blink Saheeli again (resetting her to 3 loyalty, fresh object once more).

6. Repeat step 5 (fresh Saheeli's −2 → new hasty Felidar Guardian copy → that copy's ETB blinks Saheeli back to 3 loyalty) until you have created a total of **10** hasty 1/4 artifact Felidar Guardian copies.

   - Your opponent will almost certainly spend 3 of Walking Ballista's counters to kill Reckless Fireweaver at some point during this process, shutting off its damage trigger. This is irrelevant — the loop only needs Saheeli Rai and a Felidar Guardian to copy, so it keeps generating hasty token attackers regardless of whether Fireweaver lives or dies. (If they *don't* kill Fireweaver, you simply win even faster from its triggers.)

7. Tap your remaining Needle Spires for {R} and cast Shock at your opponent's face for 2 damage.

8. Move to combat and attack with Spell Queller, Whirler Virtuoso, Reckless Fireweaver (if it survived), and all 10 hasty Felidar Guardian tokens.

9. The opponent has at most two blockers (Winding Constrictor and whatever remains of Walking Ballista), neither with flying or reach, so Spell Queller's 2 damage is always unblockable. Even if they optimally block your two strongest ground attackers (Whirler Virtuoso for 2 and one token for 1) and use any leftover Walking Ballista activation (which can't kill any 4-toughness token or 3-toughness creature by itself), at least 9 tokens (9 damage) plus Spell Queller (2 damage) get through — 11 combat damage — plus the 2 from Shock, for **at least 13 total damage**, more than enough to take the opponent from 10 life to 0 or below.

This guarantees lethal damage regardless of how/when the opponent uses Walking Ballista's ability or how they choose to block.
